text:
elaine-sales: FYI — Aurora Health wants to run a short POC next week and asks if we can onboard a new variant 'maple-3b-q4_0' into the catalog for their data-in-prod tests. They expect ~40 RPS with 256 seq and want KV-cache preserved across requests.

sam-se: Do we have the model artifact yet? q4_0 usually fine but need the quantization metadata (scales + block size). Also which container/hw they plan to run on? hosted or dedicated?

elaine-sales: Customer will try hosted first, but they'd like a path to Dedicated if performance looks good. I attached the file list they sent in the email: model.pt, tokenizer.json, quant_meta.json.

maria-ml: Quick gut check — maple-3b fp32 -> q4_0 is supported by our offline converter, but we haven't validated that variant end-to-end on our hosted fleet. Two things to flag: 1) seq=256 increases KV cache memory pressure; 2) some fused kernels we use for q4_0 are only in the 2024.3 runtime build.

devin-runtime: Right — current hosted prod (runtime 2024.2) doesn't include the new q4_0 fused kernels on older A100 images. We can run it but expect ~15-25% latency regression vs fp16. If Aurora can accept a canary, we can push a test job on a 2024.3 staging pool.

elaine-sales: Can we get a canary? Customer wants to start Tuesday.

maria-ml: Action: we need the model tarball and a small prompt set (~50 prompts) to run quality + perf. If they care about KV persistence across requests we'll include a streaming + multi-turn script.

raj-ae: Pricing note: hosted q4_0 on canary will be charged at standard hosted rate; if they move to Dedicated we should propose a mixed commit with surge credits for the first month (to absorb onboarding spikes). I'll draft a proposal.

elaine-sales: @tess-sec they sent back a short security questionnaire — main asks: encryption at rest, KMS integration, and whether quantized artifacts leave customer storage. Can you advise?

tess-sec: Short answers: storage encrypted at rest (AES-256), we integrate with customer KMS for Private deployments; hosted uses our managed KMS but we can sign an attestation. Quantized files: if they upload to our hosted flow, artifacts are persisted in our object store for the session retention window; we can set retention to 30 days for the POC. Need customer approval on retention SLA.

sam-se: For the onboarding checklist: 1) get model tarball + quant_meta, 2) run conversion/validation on staging 2024.3, 3) perf runs (latency + RPS) with seq256 and KV enabled, 4) security attestation, 5) pricing note and commit options.

maria-ml: I can run the validation tests if they provide the tarball by EOD Monday. If we see generator regressions vs fp16 we may recommend the interim fallback: maple-3b-fp16 (same tokenizer) until kernels land.

devin-runtime: I'll reserve a small canary pool (2x A100-80GB) for Tuesday AM. deploy-bot: will post when pool is ready.

deploy-bot: Canary pool provisioned (pool-id: canary-maple-1749) — you can schedule jobs.

elaine-sales: Great. I'll ask Aurora for the tarball, 50 prompt set, and confirm retention = 30 days. If they push back on retention we'll ask sales/legal for a one-off. Thanks team :thumbsup:

raj-ae: I'll start the pricing draft and include a Dedicated bridging credit scenario.

maria-ml: tagging quick notes: please include a few safety prompts in the test set (PHI redaction checks).

elaine-sales: noted — will request those. We'll reconvene Monday after I get their bundle.Thanks everyone.
